redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/benchmark.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: no tally or error reader matched its output, so no line of it is quoted as decisive; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; no ignored dependency directory linked from the project root; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home); deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

Outside the declared files: tests/evals.test.mjs e19/e20 failed once the evidence directory existed, because its evidenceFiles() walked evidence/ recursively and required the evals README cost table to name every JSON there, the benchmark files included. Added a one-line filter that leaves evidence/benchmark/ out of that walk (with a two-line comment); the plan gate allowed the Edit. Commands, run from the project dir: node --test tests/denylist.test.mjs tests/benchmark.test.mjs -> exit 0, 22 pass 0 fail 0 skipped; node --test -> exit 0, 482 tests, 482 pass, 0 fail (before the evals.test.mjs filter: exit 1, e19 and e20 failing on the benchmark files). All new and changed files staged with git add; nothing committed. Dependants: run-candidate.sh, PROTOCOL.md's other sections, tests/cost-profile.test.mjs, tests/readme.test.mjs, the evals README: still correct, unchanged, and their tests pass in the full run. tests/evals.test.mjs changed as above, so its README cost-section check now covers the evals' own evidence only. .agents/skills/node files matched by basename only and are not affected.
outcome.descriptive: The release benchmark's 13 cost profiles and their summary are now tracked, PROTOCOL.md records how the runs went, and six tests hold the files to the naming rule, the summary and the protocol's rate date.
